package.name: emori_skill_native
package.description: Native v2 skill transport: lets the skill facade submit motions through the emori_adapter core in-process. A bounded skill request becomes GoTo / PlayRecordedMove goals on the native Reachy Mini ROS 2 node, with no HTTP hop and no daemon in the path, and it reuses the hostapp's own skill-to-intent mapping, so the robot performs exactly the same gesture whichever side asked for it. The facade finds it by entry point (emori_skill_facade.transports), so no standalone package ever imports this one.
package.author: Pokamind AB
